stemMd: A function has values f(1)=4, f(2)=7 and f(3)=10 and is known to be linear. What is f(5)?
explanationMd: A linear function with equal input steps has constant output differences. The difference is three, so f(x)=3x+1. At five this gives sixteen. The statement that the function is linear is needed to determine the continuation.

distractorRationale.a: This is the value at four.
distractorRationale.b: This ignores the intercept of one.
distractorRationale.e: This multiplies the first output by the new input.
distractorRationale.d: This advances one step too far.
